content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in New Haven

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds for the PMP credential. Gather proof of your qualifying work history and educational credentials before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our certified practitioners deliver real-world project-management frameworks and exam-focused content via interactive online sessions. Complete all required contact hours on a schedule that fits your work commitments at Yale New Haven Health System, Alexion Pharmaceuticals, or your current employer.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After training completion, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application with documentation of education and experience. Pay the required examination fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI's review and approval before scheduling your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and targeted study guides. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or approved remote location. Our instructors remain available to clarify complex concepts before your exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew your credential. PMI accepts PDUs from training, volunteer work, publications, and conference attendance. Plan your ongoing learning across the standard renewal cycle to keep your certification active and competitive in New Haven's healthcare, insurance, and advanced-manufacturing sectors.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
